test_name: mapped ELF x86 conditional return at a segment edge
inspiration: Synthetic linked ELF x86 paths are lost when fall-through consumes unmapped loader padding.
acceptance_evidence: The registered input (5ee1f28c, SHA-256 506fc3c8a43d480bdb877c8dd192e3a6c062013c5dd88a119e6c7cedf5ced890) failed on the earlier head at a partial tail instruction: its text ends mov cs,eax and three zero padding bytes, the last of which needs a ModRM byte past the mapped end. With truncated-instruction recovery, kuna decompile keygenme 0x804834c --addr --json exits 0 with code and a null error (1,018,172 characters, the whole movfuscated text as one function); option off still exits 1 at r0x080d1955.
decisions: Limit recovery to matching linked little-endian ELF i386/x86-64 images.
Snapshot current loader shared bytes only for the flow lifetime, preserving exclusive byte overlays.
Validate actual consumed instruction bytes before SLEIGH context commits or p-code emission; do not require mapped prefetch padding.
Register the missing halt immediately for an unmapped effective successor, so queued targets resolve through p-code-free chains; later stub filling reuses it.
Retain known-function, declared-range fatal/warning/ignore, explicit return, and no-return precedence; branches may cross gaps to mapped destinations.

End an instruction that decoded flow reaches on a mapped byte, but whose length-only decode runs past the contiguous mapped run, in a one-byte missing halt at its own address; keep errors for the flow's own entry instruction, read failures on mapped bytes and genuine decode errors.
Exclude in-lined callee flows from both cuts: the in-line clone turns a callee RETURN into a branch to the return address, so a missing halt would read as a normal return.

Preserve overlapbranch recovery for a rejected fall-through span only when length-only probes prove a complete mapped target with a different end; never lift padded bytes or admit an incomplete target.

Refresh only stale mapping warnings after replacement flow succeeds, including with recovery disabled; publish buffered comments at that point so failed reloads preserve the previous body and its diagnostics.
Allow an explicitly expected stage-command error before the default-on witness; collect output independently of the console redirect, without reopening a closed stream.

Share an op already registered at a cut address during stub filling only when it is a missing halt; any other op there (a funcboundflow no-return halt) keeps its own edge and the branch gets a fresh stub, as upstream stub filling does.
